p: Buzite: Which came from Buz, the son of Nahor, Abraham's brother.
Ram: Or, as the Chaldee translation reads, Abram.
rather than God: By making himself innocent, and by charging God of rigour.
they were elder than he: That is, the three mentioned before.
should speak: Meaning, the ancient, who have experience.
and the inspiration of the Almighty: It is a special gift of God that man has understanding and comes neither from nature nor by age.
what to say: To prove that Job's affliction came for his sins.
found out wisdom: Flatter yourselves as though you had overcome him.
he hath not directed his words: That is, Job.
him with your speeches: He uses almost the same arguments but without taunting and reproaches.
matter: I have conceived in my mind a great store of reasons.
neither let me give flattering titles: I will neither have regard for riches, credit, nor authority but will speak the very truth.
titles: The Hebrew word signifies to change the name as to call a fool a wise man: meaning, that he would not cloak the truth to flatter men.
